title: Investors reported deceased (KRA, daily)
purpose: The KRA's daily demise data: PANs of investors whose death was reported through the KRA. Matched like NSE's monthly demise list: debits blocked at once, UCCs closed on every exchange. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Loaded on Compliance → Deceased clients: debits blocked for each client matched.
source: NSE/ISC/75724 (circular 37/2026: the KRAs share demise data daily); MCX/S&I/522/2026 para 2; SEBI/HO/OIAE/OIAE_IAD-1/P/CIR/2023/0000000163. The columns are not published: read by header names.
